prose: The Washington Post, via AP, reports that Satya Nadella and Michael Dell received the National Medal of Technology and Innovation at a White House event where President Trump celebrated tech billionaires. The timing was awkward: hours earlier Vice President Vance accused Microsoft of abusing the visa system to bring in foreign workers.
highlights: Nadella and Dell awarded the National Medal of Technology
Trump celebrated tech leaders at the event
Same day Vance accused Microsoft of visa abuse
Report from AP via the Washington Post
